1.name: Ozzy Lusth

references.view: Ep. 3 Aitu confessional, near-front face and pendant
Ep. 5 Aitu confessional, three-quarter face and dry curl texture
Ep. 7 challenge lineup, center, full silhouette and charcoal shorts

face.shape: Oval upper face with a narrower lower jaw and rounded chin. Modestly pronounced cheekbone below the outer eye.
face.forehead: Moderate exposed forehead with irregular curls, more covered at the temples.
face.eyesAndBrows: Dark, moderately spaced almond-shaped eyes beneath substantial brows. Outer brow tapers. Upper lids sit closer to the iris than in the illustrated avatar.
face.nose: Defined, mostly straight bridge with a gently rounded tip and modestly flared nostrils.
face.mouthAndChin: Medium-width mouth, defined upper-lip peaks and fuller lower lip. Narrow sparse mustache and patch below the lower lip with scattered jaw stubble.
face.ears: Largely hidden by hair. Use base anatomy under the side curls.

1.hair: Dark brown with sun-lightened tips, unruly curls, asymmetric loose part, full at the temples and down to the nape. The illustrated avatar has longer, straighter hair and heavier facial hair.
1.body: Lean swimmer build with defined shoulders and chest, relatively narrow waist and long limbs.
1.clothing: Shirtless challenge look, charcoal board shorts and small round pendant on a thin dark cord. No marks or typography.
priorities: Short layered curls with an irregular hairline
Reduced lower-face width and heavy beard
uncertainties: Full orthographic profile and unobstructed ears unavailable in inspected frames
Accessory colors and footwear vary across episodes

3.name: Natalie Anderson

references.view: Ep. 1 confessional, blue head buff, brows and hair texture
Ep. 3 confessional, near frontal face, hair and shoulders
Ep. 9 lineup, natural smile and released hair
Season intro, profile and athletic top

face.shape: Broad cheek region, softly tapered lower face and rounded chin.
face.forehead: Moderate height. Dark, slightly off-center part where visible.
face.eyesAndBrows: Dark almond eyes and substantial arched brows. Strong lower lid and cheek lift in the smile.
face.nose: Moderate bridge and rounded tip. Front view is clearer than the wet intro profile.
face.mouthAndChin: Full lips, wide smile and compact chin.

3.hair: Long dark roots with light brown and honey lengths. Wavy when dry, looser strands after water. Blue forehead buff is a verified option.
3.body: Athletic shoulders and upper arms, compact silhouette.
3.clothing: Turquoise athletic top and blue cloth buff appear together in the intro. Violet shirt also appears in early episodes.
priorities: Broad cheek plane and natural smile
uncertainties: Ear shape and lower-body tailoring are not resolved in the selected close-ups

4.name: Boston Rob Mariano

references.view: Ep. 1 Maraamu confessional, three-quarter face, hair and chain

face.shape: Broad upper face with cheek fullness, a defined jaw and a rounded square chin.
face.forehead: Low natural irregular hairline with a short forward fringe.
face.eyesAndBrows: Dark eyes with a slightly hooded upper lid and full brows with a gradual arch.
face.nose: Defined bridge and moderately broad, rounded tip; visible projection in intro side view.
face.mouthAndChin: Medium mouth with a distinct lower lip and understated smile. Clean-shaven or faint shadow in these shots.
face.ears: Outer silhouette partly visible in three-quarter view.

4.hair: Short dark hair, loosely wavy, brushed forward at the front.
4.body: Broad neck and shoulders in early camp footage.
4.clothing: Shirtless camp appearance with a thin gold-tone chain. The later red cap and goatee in the original illustrated avatar are secondary cues.
uncertainties: Exact chain links and lower-body wardrobe are unresolved in inspected stills
